findings.title: Comma splitting invalidates quoted-cell verification
findings.why_it_matters: The U2 method splits the quoted cell "a,b" into two cells and cannot verify the required round trip.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace comma splitting with a CSV-aware round-trip check or exact expected CSV strings for the required fixtures.
evidence: U2 verifies round-trip preservation by splitting each serialized line on commas and comparing the parts with the input cells.

findings.title: Select retention to make cleanup implementable
findings.why_it_matters: U3 needs a retention constant before implementation can finish.
findings.suggested_fix: Set retention to 7 days in the Product Contract and U3.
evidence: U3 implements the cleanup job after the retention choice is settled.

findings.title: Repeat the quoting rule in U1
findings.why_it_matters: An implementer reading only U1 might not see the quoting definition.
findings.suggested_fix: Copy the complete quoting rule into U1.
evidence: U1 implements CSV with the Planning Contract's quoting rules and tests ordinary and quoted values.
